change: Validate every argument operator and typed field, but require positions 0 through 5 only for a known syscall with a nondefault action. Ignored argument positions never become compiled conditions. Preserve active-rule validation, the case-insensitive parser, zero-mask normalization and the host boundary.

public_reference.thread_setup: LockOSThread, as in runc init; observe /proc/thread-self/status and unchanged thread ID across installation and queries.

actual_unit_tests.scope: Actual Cargo init test executable, including existing kernel-enforcement regressions. New tests also cover ignored uint64 index boundaries, invalid operators/typed fields and invalid active positions before zero-mask removal.

hosted_api_tests.status: syntax checked; execution pending before merge

earlier_reference_assessment.update: The earlier index-only controls covered conversion alone. This follow-up invokes the actual loader and verifies kernel outcomes; both ignored-index differences are now corrected. The earlier invalid-operator exclusion remains valid.

limitations: Two conditional-rule ordering differences remain unresolved.
The bounded kernel comparison allows all syscalls by default and only restricts getppid; the default-deny control is excluded.
This does not execute runc containers, Docker or Podman, prove whole-compiler equivalence, or add a formal proof.
The first kernel probe read the process leader rather than the exact Go OS thread; its strict counter check failed and it remains excluded. The corrected probe locks and observes the exact thread.

The first reference build lacked a public syscall-header include path; the first Rust caller link used the host linker. Both failures are retained; no original reference/runtime source was changed to bypass them.
Hosted candidate qualification, public publication and release installation are pending.
